item.content:encoded:
AI 开源趋势日报 2026-06-28

数据来源: GitHub Trending + GitHub Search API | 生成时间: 2026-06-28 10:09 UTC

好的，作为一名专注于 AI 开源生态的技术分析师，我将基于您提供的 2026-06-28 数据，为您生成一份结构清晰的《AI 开源趋势日报》。

AI 开源趋势日报

日期：2026-06-28 | 分析师：AI 开源生态技术分析师

1. 今日速览

今日 GitHub 趋势榜与 AI 主题搜索共同指向一个核心信号：AI 编码代理与智能体生态正在全面爆发。Trending 榜单上，opencode、gstack、design.md 等围绕编码代理（Coding Agent）的工具和规范密集涌现，标志着从“使用 AI 辅助编码”到“用 AI 管理编码流程”的范式转变。同时，以 cognee 和 mem0 为代表的智能体记忆层成为新的基础设施热点，为打造持久上下文、拥有长期记忆的 AI 智能体提供了关键支撑。此外，AI 在量化金融（ai-berkshire, Vibe-Trading）和内容克隆/生成（ai-website-cloner-template, Open-Generative-AI）等垂直领域的应用也呈现百花齐放态势。

2. 各维度热门项目

🔧 AI 基础工具 (框架、SDK、推理引擎、CLI)

  • google-labs-code/design.md ⭐ 未知 (+1541 today) 一项前所未有的提案，通过 DESIGN.md 文件为编码代理提供持久且结构化的视觉设计系统认知，是定义“AI 原生开发规范”的革命性尝试。

  • anomalyco/opencode ⭐ 未知 (+392 today) 一款开源的编码代理，旨在成为继 Claude Code 之后又一个强大的 AI 驱动开发助手，今日热度高涨，预示社区对自托管方案的需求。

  • garrytan/gstack ⭐ 未知 (+674 today) 封装了 Garry Tan 个人使用的 23 个 Claude Code 工具集，将 CEO、设计师、工程经理等角色工作流 Agent 化，是“个人 AI 工作流”的最佳实践范本。

  • topoteretes/cognee ⭐ 24,321 (+780 today) 开源的 AI 智能体记忆平台。通过自托管的图数据库引擎，为智能体提供跨会话的长期记忆，是解决 AI 智能体“失忆症”的关键基础设施。

  • langchain-ai/langchain ⭐ 140,368 智能体工程平台，大模型应用开发的事实标准框架之一，持续在 RAG 和 Agent 领域保持领先地位。

  • ollama/ollama ⭐ 175,031 本地运行大模型的首选工具，现已支持 Kimi-2.6、DeepSeek 等最新模型，是本地化部署和开发的核心入口。

  • Fission-AI/OpenSpec ⭐ 未知 (+177 today) 为 AI 编码助手设计的“规范驱动开发”框架，旨在通过“先写规范，后写代码”的方式，提升 AI 生成代码的质量和可控性。

🤖 AI 智能体/工作流（Agent 框架、自动化、多智能体）

  • xbtlin/ai-berkshire ⭐ 未知 (+685 today) AI 时代的价值投资研究框架。集成巴菲特、段永平等多位大师的方法论，通过多智能体对抗分析进行投资研究，是将 Agent 用于金融量化分析的代表性作品。

  • HKUDS/Vibe-Trading ⭐ 未知 (+92 today) 个人交易 Agent，利用 AI 操盘可能的高波动性（“Vibe”）来获利，探索 AI 在短线交易场景的潜力。

  • NousResearch/hermes-agent ⭐ 204,588 一个“与你共同成长”的智能体项目，强调智能体的自适应性和长期演进能力，是社区关注的焦点。

  • browser-use/browser-use ⭐ 101,042 为 AI 智能体提供“浏览网页”能力的开源库，让 Agent 能像人类一样自动化完成在线任务，是 RPA（机器人流程自动化）的 AI 替代方案。

  • Significant-Gravitas/AutoGPT ⭐ 185,190 自主 AI 智能体的先驱，社区持续探索其完成任务、设定子目标、迭代前行的能力，代表了通用自主 Agent 的愿景。

  • bytedance/deer-flow ⭐ 75,123 字节跳动开源的“超级 Agent”架构，专为处理需要数小时完成的长周期任务设计，通过沙盒、记忆、子智能体和消息网关等组件来实现复杂自动化。

  • shareAI-lab/learn-claude-code ⭐ 68,737 一个“从零开始构建 Agent 框架”的教育项目，用简洁的代码展示了 Agent 的核心原理，是开发者学习 Agent 内部机制的绝佳教材。

📦 AI 应用（具体应用产品、垂直场景解决方案）

  • commaai/openpilot ⭐ 未知 (+322 today) 为 300+ 车型提供高级驾驶辅助系统的开源机器人操作系统，是 AI 在物理世界中最具影响力的应用之一。

  • JCodesMore/ai-website-cloner-template ⭐ 未知 (+750 today) 只需一条指令就能利用 AI 编码代理克隆任何网站，极大降低了网页克隆的门槛，展示了 AI Agent 在网站开发/复刻领域的潜力。

  • Anil-matcha/Open-Generative-AI ⭐ 未知 (+255 today) 一款无审查的开源 AI 视频/图像生成工作室，集成了 200+ 模型，是商业化 AI 平台（如 Midjourney、Sora）的强大开源替代。

  • siyuan-note/siyuan ⭐ 44,697 隐私优先、完全开源的个人知识管理系统，已深度整合 AI Agent 能力，是构建第二大脑的热门选择。

  • CherryHQ/cherry-studio ⭐ 47,909 集成了智能聊天、自主 Agent 和 300+ 助手的一站式 AI 效率办公平台，是 AI 生产力工具的多合一解决方案。

  • hugohe3/ppt-master ⭐ 33,435 利用 AI 将任何文档一键生成为可编辑的 PowerPoint 文件，并支持语音旁白，极大提升了演示文稿制作效率。

🧠 大模型/训练 (模型权重、训练框架、微调工具)

  • huggingface/transformers ⭐ 161,983 ML 模型的事实标准框架，支持几乎所有主流模型的推理和训练，是 AI 生态的基石。

  • vllm-project/vllm ⭐ 84,624 高性能 LLM 推理和服务引擎，为 AI 应用提供了极高的吞吐量和内存效率，是服务端部署的核心组件。

  • jingyaogong/minimind ⭐ 52,274 “2小时从零训练小模型”的项目，大幅降低了 LLM 训练的学习门槛，是教育和研究领域的热门资源。

  • zjunlp/LightThinker ⭐ 164 EMNLP 2025 论文项目，提出“边思考边压缩”的推理方法，旨在减少大模型的推理 Token 消耗，是提升效率的前沿研究。

🔍 RAG/知识库 (向量数据库、检索增强、知识管理)

  • langgenius/dify ⭐ 146,808 生产级 RAG 与 Agentic Workflow 开发平台，是构建基于知识库的 AI 应用的首选，生态繁荣。

  • infiniflow/ragflow ⭐ 83,766 领先的开源 RAG 引擎，深度融合 RAG 与 Agent 能力，为 LLM 提供顶级的上下文层，是企业级知识库应用的标杆。

  • milvus-io/milvus ⭐ 44,986 高性能云原生向量数据库，是支撑大规模 RAG 应用的核心数据基础设施。

  • mem0ai/mem0 ⭐ 59,611 通用的 AI 智能体记忆层，与 cognee 遥相呼应，共同定义了 Agent 记忆基础设施这一新赛道。

  • qdrant/qdrant ⭐ 32,711 高性能、高可用的向量搜索引擎，与 Milvus 并列为最受欢迎的专用向量数据库之一。

  • VectifyAI/PageIndex ⭐ 33,478 提出了一种“无向量、基于推理”的新一代 RAG 思路，挑战了传统的向量检索范式，值得研究。

3. 趋势信号分析

  1. AI 编码代理生态大爆发：今日热榜上，编码代理成为最炙手可热的类别。opencode（开源替代）、gstack（工作流集成）、design.md（规范标准化）和OpenSpec（规范驱动），从不同维度推动着 AI 编码代理从“个人玩具”向“团队生产力工具”演进。这表明社区正在寻求更可控、更结构化、更符合软件工程规范的 AI 开发流程，而非简单的代码补全。

  2. “智能体记忆”成为新基础设施：cognee 和 mem0 两个项目的热度，揭示了一个关键趋势——AI 智能体的长期记忆能力已成为解决“上下文窗口限制”和“会话碎片化”的核心痛点。不再仅仅是 RAG（检索增强生成），而是进入“MAG”（记忆增强生成）时代，为智能体构建一个能持久学习、积累经验和知识的“大脑”。

  3. AI 与数据/金融深度融合：ai-berkshire、Vibe-Trading 等项目的出现，以及传统数据工具 dbt-core（虽未入选 AI 类别，但数据是 AI 基础）的持续活跃，表明 AI 正在快速渗透到投资分析和量化交易领域。开发者不再满足于用 AI 写代码，而是开始用 AI 来“做决策”，推动“AI + 量化”从小众实验走向社区主流。

4. 社区关注热点

  • anomalyco/opencode：作为 Claude Code 的开源替代，它是当前“AI 编码代理”赛道最值得关注的新星。如果您关心 AI 编程的未来和自托管方案，务必关注。
  • topoteretes/cognee 和 mem0ai/mem0：这两个项目定义了“智能体记忆”赛道。它们提供了解决 AI Agent “过目就忘”问题的实际方案，是构建真正有用、能长期协作的智能体的关键。
  • xbtlin/ai-berkshire：将复杂的多智能体协作用于价值投资研究，其代码框架和理念对于所有希望探索 AI 在金融/决策分析领域应用的人来说，都是极佳的参考。
  • OpenBB-finance/OpenBB：虽然分类在 ML 下，但它是“金融数据平台 + AI Agents”的集大成者。为 AI Agent 提供标准、结构化的金融市场数据接口，是构建 AI 量化交易应用的底层基础设施。
  • google-labs-code/design.md：这是一个前瞻性的规范。如果它被广泛采用，将从根本上改变前端开发者与 AI 编码代理的协作方式，值得所有前端和 AI 工具开发者深入思考。

本日报由 agents-radar 自动生成。

item.content:encoded:
AI Open Source Trends 2026-06-28

Sources: GitHub Trending + GitHub Search API | Generated: 2026-06-28 10:09 UTC

AI Open Source Trends Report — 2026-06-28

1. Today’s Highlights

AI coding agents continue to dominate the trending chart, with anomalyco/opencode (a new open-source coding agent) and garrytan/gstack (a curated Claude Code toolset) both earning hundreds of stars. The surge of “agent harnesses” – lightweight frameworks that give Claude Code, Codex, and similar tools structured memory, skills, and workflows – signals a shift from raw model usage to production-ready agent infrastructure. Meanwhile, topoteretes/cognee (knowledge graph memory for agents) and Fission-AI/OpenSpec (spec-driven development) reflect growing demand for persistent context and deterministic agent behavior. Financial AI agents also break into the top tier with xbtlin/ai-berkshire (value investing research) and HKUDS/Vibe-Trading (personal trading agent), indicating that agentic workflows are moving beyond developer tools into vertical domains.

2. Top Projects by Category

🔧 AI Infrastructure (Frameworks, SDKs, Inference, Dev Tools, CLI)

  • google-labs-code/design.md – ⭐0 (+1,541 today)
    A format specification for feeding design systems to coding agents, enabling persistent visual identity understanding.

  • luongnv89/claude-howto – ⭐0 (+141 today)
    Visual, example-driven guide to Claude Code – from basics to advanced agents with copy-paste templates.

  • Fission-AI/OpenSpec – ⭐0 (+177 today)
    Spec-driven development (SDD) for AI coding assistants – bridges requirements and code generation.

  • ollama/ollama – ⭐175,031 (topic:llm)
    The go-to local LLM runner, now supporting Kimi, GLM, MiniMax, DeepSeek, and latest models.

  • vllm-project/vllm – ⭐84,624 (topic:llm)
    High-throughput LLM inference engine powering many AI applications.

  • firecrawl/firecrawl – ⭐140,317 (topic:llm)
    Scalable web interaction API for AI agents – search, scrape, and act on live websites.

  • browser-use/browser-use – ⭐101,042 (topic:llm)
    Makes websites accessible to AI agents – a critical infrastructure layer for autonomous browsing.

🤖 AI Agents / Workflows (Frameworks, Automation, Multi-Agent)

  • anomalyco/opencode – ⭐0 (+392 today)
    A new open-source coding agent – direct competitor to Claude Code and Codex, gaining rapid traction.

3. Trend Signal Analysis

Agent Harnesses Are the New “Next.js for AI”
Projects like garrytan/gstack, topoteretes/cognee, and the rapid rise of anomalyco/opencode indicate that the community is moving beyond single-prompt agents toward opinionated, production-ready harnesses. The number of repositories that begin “Claude Code setup with X tools” or “agent harness for Claude/Codex” has exploded, reflecting a maturation of the coding agent ecosystem.

The use of knowledge graphs and vector databases for agent context is becoming standard. The emergence of design.md (format spec for visual identity) hints that context isn’t just factual – it includes design systems and behavioral constraints. This points to a future where agents are “personality-aware” and maintain a consistent identity across tasks.

Spec-Driven Development
Fission-AI/OpenSpec and google-labs-code/design.md represent a new pattern: instead of writing code, developers write specifications (specs, design tokens) and let AI generate the implementation. This could reduce iteration friction and make AI coding agents more reliable, especially for UI and enterprise applications.

  • topoteretes/cognee (⭐0, +780 today) – Knowledge-graph-backed memory for agents. The high star velocity suggests widespread need for persistent context in agentic workflows.

  • xbtlin/ai-berkshire (⭐0, +685 today) – First “value investing agent” to combine four legendary investing methodologies with multi-agent adversarial analysis. Signals a new vertical for AI agents.

  • JCodesMore/ai-website-cloner-template (⭐0, +750 today) – A practical demonstration of AI coding agents for real-world web cloning. Indicates growing trust in agent-generated code quality.

  • garrytan/gstack (⭐0, +674 today) – A curated “CEO-to-QA” toolset for Claude Code. Its opinionated structure may become a reference pattern for production agent setups.

  • mem0ai/mem0 (⭐59,611 total) – Universal memory layer for agents. A mature project with sustained popularity, now essential for any agent wanting cross-session recall.

Hacker News AI 社区动态日报 2026-06-28

数据来源: Hacker News | 共 30 条 | 生成时间: 2026-06-28 10:09 UTC

Hacker News AI 社区动态日报（2026-06-28）

今日速览

今日 HN 社区围绕 Anthropic 与中美 AI 博弈 展开激烈讨论，多条高赞帖子聚焦于亚洲初创公司推出类 Mythos 模型、特朗普政府释放 Anthropic 模型、以及中国在网络安全领域对齐能力的提升。与此同时，GPU 算力紧缺 与 AI 财务泡沫担忧 成为另一热点，Oracle 股价大跌引发投资者对 AI 资本支出的质疑。工具层面，多个开源项目聚焦 LLM 推理优化（RDMA 集群、KV 缓存修剪、路由管理），社区反响积极。整体情绪凸显出对 AI 权力集中化 的隐忧，以及 开源与小型企业寻求突围 的行动力。

热门新闻与讨论

🔬 模型与研究

  1. Asian AI startups launch Mythos-like models
    链接：TechCrunch | HN讨论
    分数：232 | 评论：175
    一句话：亚洲多家 AI 初创在 Anthropic 出口禁令持续背景下推出对标 Mythos 的模型，社区对此高度关注，认为地缘政治正在重塑模型供应格局，讨论集中于技术可行性及开源替代的可能。

  2. Anthropic says Alibaba used 25k accounts to mine Claude
    链接：Ars Technica | HN讨论
    分数：37 | 评论：30
    一句话：Anthropic 指控阿里巴巴利用 2.5 万个账户大规模爬取 Claude 能力，社区对此反应两极——有人质疑指控证据，也有人认为这是 AI 间谍战升级的标志。

  3. China Has Matched Anthropic in Cybersecurity, Resetting AI Race
    链接：WSJ | HN讨论
    分数：12 | 评论：3
    一句话：华尔街日报称中国在网络安全能力上已对齐 Anthropic 水平，社区认为这暗示芯片限制并未阻止中国在模型安全层快速追赶。

🛠️ 工具与工程

  1. AMD Strix Halo RDMA Cluster Setup Guide
    链接：GitHub | HN讨论
    分数：141 | 评论：42
    一句话：一份针对 AMD Strix Halo 加速器搭建 RDMA 集群的详尽指南，社区赞扬其在 vLLM 环境下对推理吞吐量的显著提升，被视为 Nvidia GPU 短缺下的务实替代方案。

  2. Wayfinder Router: deterministic routing of queries between local and hosted LLM
    链接：GitHub | HN讨论
    分数：68 | 评论：16
    一句话：一款在本地与托管 LLM 之间进行确定性路由的工具，社区认为其解决了混合部署中的成本与延迟权衡，是 Agent 工作流中的重要基础设施。

  3. Show HN: KV-psi, using Linux PSI to trim an LLM KV cache
    链接：GitHub | HN讨论
    分数：6 | 评论：0
    一句话：利用 Linux 压力阻塞信息（PSI）动态裁剪 LLM KV 缓存的轻量方案，虽评论少但获开发者点赞，代表社区对长上下文推理内存优化的持续关注。

  4. I patched llama.cpp to gain 20% prompt processing TPS
    链接：无独立链接，见 HN讨论
    分数：4 | 评论：2
    一句话：一位开发者分享对 llama.cpp 的补丁实现 20% 的提示处理吞吐提升，呼吁社区协助提交 PR，体现开源社区对推理底层优化的热情。

🏢 产业动态

  1. Trump Admin Releases Anthropic Mythos
    链接：TechCrunch | HN讨论
    分数：4 | 评论：0
    一句话：特朗普政府已正式释放 Anthropic 的 Mythos 模型，允许超 100 家美国企业和机构使用，社区虽有零星讨论但热度不高，可能因这一举动此前已被预期。

  2. Google caps Meta's Gemini use as AI demand strains capacity
    链接：FT | HN讨论
    分数：4 | 评论：0
    一句话：因 AI 需求爆发性增长导致算力紧张，Google 对 Meta 的 Gemini 使用实施配额限制，反映出大厂之间算力分配的隐性竞争。

  3. Oracle stock worst week since 2001 dot-com bust, AI financing concerns escalate
    链接：CNBC | HN讨论
    分数：4 | 评论：1
    一句话：Oracle 股价遭遇 2001 年以来最差单周表现，投资者对 AI 融资可持续性产生恐慌，社区开始讨论这一轮 AI 泡沫何时破裂。

  4. Legion LegalTech sues U.S. over Anthropic Fable 5 and Mythos 5 shutdown
    链接：TheNextWeb | HN讨论
    分数：4 | 评论：0
    一句话：法律科技公司起诉美国政府要求恢复对 Anthropic Fable 5 等模型的访问权，凸显企业对模型突然下线的合规与业务中断焦虑。

💬 观点与争议

  1. Everyone feared AI taking over; the real danger is AI serving just the few
    链接：无独立链接，见 HN讨论
    分数：67 | 评论：40
    一句话：帖子提出“AI 被少数精英垄断”比“AI 接管人类”更迫在眉睫，社区对此高度认同，讨论集中在地缘隔离、许可证限制对 AI 民主化的威胁。

  2. Show HN: Decomp Academy – Learn to decompile GameCube games into matching C
    链接：decomp-academy.dev | HN讨论
    分数：122 | 评论：44
    一句话：虽非直接 AI 项目，但反编译教学引入了神经网络辅助代码匹配，社区称赞其对复古游戏逆向工程的贡献及 AI 辅助编码的趣味应用。

  3. Show HN: Adrafinil – keep a lid-closed Mac awake only while agents work
    链接：GitHub | HN讨论
    分数：108 | 评论：71
    一句话：一款在合盖状态下保持 Mac 唤醒直到 AI Agent 任务完成的工具，社区围绕 Mac 的功耗管理、Agent 自动化的边界展开了热烈讨论。

  4. Peppa Pig studio wants to clone child actors' voices with AI indefinitely
    链接：GadgetReview | HN讨论
    分数：21 | 评论：15
    一句话：小猪佩奇动画工作室提出永久克隆儿童演员声音的 AI 条款，遭到近千条行业反对，社区聚焦于 AI 对儿童权益和劳动法的冲击。

社区情绪信号

今日 HN 社区最活跃的 AI 话题集中在地缘政治对模型供应的撕裂（排名第 1 的帖子和第 9、11 条）以及算力紧缺下的基础设施创新（排名第 2、6、16 条）。高赞帖（232 分）关于亚洲初创推出类 Mythos 模型引发激烈讨论（175 条评论），社区明显担忧出口禁令反而加速了全球多极化模型生态的成型，同时有声音质疑这种碎片化是否会导致安全标准下降。

另一个显著争论点是 AI 是否正在被少数巨头和主权国家垄断（第 7 条观点帖获 67 分）。与上周相比，社区焦点从单纯的模型能力对比转向了模型访问权、许可证限制和融资可持续性。Oracle 股价暴跌（第 23 条）和 Google 对 Meta 的配额限制（第 22 条）暗示投资者和从业者对当前 AI 支出规模开始产生泡沫警惕。

整体情绪呈现出 “积极突围”与“深度焦虑”并存：一方面，AMD 集群指南、路由器和 KV 缓存优化等开源项目获得开发者社区的热情点赞；另一方面，关于儿童声音克隆、农民因超时参加数据中心会议被逮捕（第 5 条，虽非 AI 直接相关但涉及基础设施争议）等事件反映出底层不满正在蔓延。

值得深读

  1. Asian AI startups launch Mythos-like models
    TechCrunch + HN讨论
    理由：该帖以 232 分成为今日最高分，175 条评论剖析了亚洲模型生态的现状、地缘政治影响及未来走向，对理解全球 AI 格局变化至关重要。

  2. AMD Strix Halo RDMA Cluster Setup Guide
    GitHub + HN讨论
    理由：141 分的高赞说明社区对 GPU 替代方案极度渴求，这篇指南提供了可复现的 AMD 集群搭建方案，对计划摆脱 Nvidia 依赖的团队具有直接参考价值。

  3. Everyone feared AI taking over; the real danger is AI serving just the few
    HN帖子
    理由：67 分、40 条评论集中呈现了社区对 AI 民主化与权力集中的反思，是当前阶段最具思想性的一篇讨论，值得开发者反思自身角色。

本日报由 agents-radar 自动生成。

item.content:encoded:
Hacker News AI Community Digest 2026-06-28

Source: Hacker News | 30 stories | Generated: 2026-06-28 10:09 UTC

Hacker News AI Community Digest — June 28, 2026

Today's Highlights

Today’s Hacker News AI discussions are dominated by geopolitical tensions in AI supply chains and infrastructure bottlenecks. The top story (232 points, 175 comments) covers Asian startups racing to launch Mythos-like models after Anthropic’s export ban, sparking debate on open-source vs. national AI sovereignty. A second high‑engagement thread (107 points, 57 comments) about a farmer arrested for exceeding a five‑second time limit at a data center highlights growing resentment over compute access inequality. Meanwhile, a popular opinion piece (67 points, 40 comments) reframes the AI risk narrative away from “takeover” toward the danger of AI serving only the powerful, resonating with many commenters.

Top News & Discussions

🔬 Models & Research

  • Asian AI startups launch Mythos-like models
    Link
    HN: 48697958
    Score: 232 | Comments: 175
    Why this matters: As Anthropic’s export restrictions tighten, Asian competitors are closing the gap; the community is divided between applauding innovation and fearing fractured AI development.

  • China Has Matched Anthropic in Cybersecurity, Resetting AI Race
    Link
    HN: 48703592
    Score: 12 | Comments: 3
    Why this matters: A claim that China’s AI security now rivals Anthropic’s, underscoring the rapid catch‑up; few comments yet, but the topic is likely to spark more discussion later.

  • Powerful Anthropic model, Fable 5, on track to return soon
    Link
    HN: 48703825
    Score: 4 | Comments: 2
    Why this matters: Fable 5 was previously shutdown amid export tensions; its return could reshape model availability – HN users are cautiously optimistic.

  • KV‑psi: using Linux PSI to trim an LLM KV cache
    Link
    HN: 48702538
    Score: 6 | Comments: 0
    Why this matters: A clever system‑level approach to reduce memory pressure in LLM inference; the quiet thread suggests a niche but technically appreciated project.

  • I patched llama.cpp to gain 20% prompt processing TPS
    Link
    HN: 48700782
    Score: 4 | Comments: 2
    Why this matters: Hands‑on optimization of the popular local inference engine; community respects low‑level performance tweaks even if the thread is small.

🛠️ Tools & Engineering

  • AMD Strix Halo RDMA Cluster Setup Guide
    Link
    HN: 48703258
    Score: 141 | Comments: 42
    Why this matters: Step‑by‑step guide for running vLLM inference on AMD hardware with RDMA; widely upvoted by engineers looking for GPU alternatives.

  • Wayfinder Router: deterministic routing of queries between local and hosted LLM
    Link
    HN: 48704373
    Score: 68 | Comments: 16
    Why this matters: A practical tool for mixing local and cloud LLMs with predictable routing – HN appreciates pragmatic solutions to latency and cost trade‑offs.

  • Show HN: Better Graphs – Teach agents to stop making plain Matplotlib slop
    Link
    HN: 48705038
    Score: 6 | Comments: 1
    Why this matters: A prompt‑based system for improving chart output from LLM agents; the light discussion hints at wider frustration with poor visualizations.

  • Show HN: Open Tag – the open source Claude Tag
    Link
    HN: 48697420
    Score: 4 | Comments: 0
    Why this matters: An open‑source alternative to Anthropic’s proprietary tagging tool – zero comments suggests early adoption but potential for interest as usage grows.

  • I patched llama.cpp to gain 20% prompt processing TPS (listed in both research and tools; we place it here for its engineering focus)
    See above.

🏢 Industry News

  • Anthropic says Alibaba used 25k accounts to mine Claude
    Link
    HN: 48699483
    Score: 37 | Comments: 30
    Why this matters: Allegations of state‑backed model theft escalate the US‑China AI conflict; HN commenters are skeptical of the evidence and worry about over‑blown narratives.

  • Peppa Pig studio wants to clone child actors’ voices with AI indefinitely
    Link
    HN: 48701902
    Score: 21 | Comments: 15
    Why this matters: A high‑profile ethical flashpoint on AI voice cloning in media; the community largely condemns the move, citing exploitation of minors.

  • Trump Admin Releases Anthropic Mythos
    Link
    HN: 48704805
    Score: 4 | Comments: 0
    Why this matters: Government forced release of Anthropic’s highly capable model to boost domestic AI – politically charged, but the thread hasn’t yet ignited.

  • Google caps Meta’s Gemini use as AI demand strains capacity
    Link
    HN: 48704836
    Score: 4 | Comments: 0
    Why this matters: Compute scarcity forces cloud providers to ration – a sign of infrastructure growing pains that will affect many companies.

💬 Opinions & Debates

  • Everyone feared AI taking over; the real danger is AI serving just the few
    Link
    HN: 48701615
    Score: 67 | Comments: 40
    Why this matters: A well‑argued piece shifting concern from AGI to access inequality; many commenters agree, while a few argue the two fears are connected.

  • A Farmer Arrested for Going 5 Seconds over His Time Limit at Data Center Meeting
    Link
    HN: 48701342
    Score: 107 | Comments: 57
    Why this matters: An absurdist story highlighting draconian compute scheduling policies; the community sees it as a symptom of AI infrastructure becoming a power‑gating gatekeeper.

  • PRs and LLMs
    Link
    HN: 48700392
    Score: 6 | Comments: 0
    Why this matters: A thoughtful article on how LLMs change code review workflows – no comments yet, but the topic is timely for developers integrating AI into their daily workflow.

Community Sentiment Signal

Today’s HN AI discussion is notably geopolitical and infrastructure‑focused. The highest‑activity threads combine high scores with large comment counts: the Asian AI clones thread (232/175) and the farmer arrest thread (107/57) draw in many participants, while the “AI serving the few” piece (67/40) shows intense ethical debate.

Controversy centers on the Anthropic‑Alibaba mining accusation (#9) – users are split between belief and suspicion of corporate propaganda. A consensus is emerging that compute access is becoming a battleground: the data center arrest story resonated because it dramatizes resource hoarding. Compared to last cycle, the conversation has shifted away from AGI existential risk and toward real‑world power struggles, export controls, and the felt scarcity of GPU cycles. The community seems more cynical about big AI companies (Anthropic, Google, Alibaba) and more supportive of open‑source alternatives like llama.cpp and local routing tools.

item.content:encoded:
Product Hunt AI Products Digest 2026-06-28

Source: Product Hunt | 8 products | Generated: 2026-06-28 10:09 UTC

Product Hunt AI Products Digest – June 28, 2026

Today's Highlights

Today’s AI launches on Product Hunt are dominated by productivity and developer tooling, with Folio AI (311 votes) leading as a PowerPoint automation tool that positions itself as “Claude for PPT.” The runner-up, QApilot’s CoWork (298 votes), targets mobile testing efficiency with a 3x speed claim. A notable trend is the rise of agentic infrastructure—tools like OpenBot and AgentGrade focus on managing and evaluating AI agents, while Cloud World Model (168 votes) offers cost-free simulation of major cloud providers. The day also saw a satire product, A.S.S.H.O.L.E., that mixes brutal honesty with utility, highlighting the playful side of AI.

Top Products by Category

🤖 AI Agents & Assistants

OpenBot — Tag specialized agents like friends or employees

  • Product Hunt: https://www.producthunt.com/products/openbot?utm_campaign=producthunt-api&utm_medium=api-v2&utm_source=Application%3A+%E5%91%A8%E6%8A%A5-workMac+%28ID%3A+287503%29
  • Website: https://www.producthunt.com/r/XMZR7WZF2F55B6?utm_campaign=producthunt-api&utm_medium=api-v2&utm_source=Application%3A+%E5%91%A8%E6%8A%A5-workMac+%28ID%3A+287503%29
  • Votes: 37 | Comments: 14
  • Solves the problem of managing multiple AI agents by allowing users to tag and invoke them like team members, standing out with its human‑friendly mental model.

Velocity 2.0 Prompt Co-Pilot — One click prompt enhancement for any AI tool, with context!

  • Product Hunt: https://www.producthunt.com/products/velocity-2-0-prompt-co-pilot?utm_campaign=producthunt-api&utm_medium=api-v2&utm_source=Application%3A+%E5%91%A8%E6%8A%A5-workMac+%28ID%3A+287503%29
  • Website: https://www.producthunt.com/r/CWMVTSF4W2H6PR?utm_campaign=producthunt-api&utm_medium=api-v2&utm_source=Application%3A+%E5%91%A8%E6%8A%A5-workMac+%28ID%3A+287503%29
  • Votes: 21 | Comments: 6
  • Solves the challenge of crafting effective prompts by augmenting any AI tool with context‑aware improvements in one click, making it a universal prompt optimiser.

A.S.S.H.O.L.E.™ — Brutally honest. Surprisingly helpful.

  • Product Hunt: https://www.producthunt.com/products/a-s-s-h-o-l-e?utm_campaign=producthunt-api&utm_medium=api-v2&utm_source=Application%3A+%E5%91%A8%E6%8A%A5-workMac+%28ID%3A+287503%29
  • Website: https://www.producthunt.com/r/WZXU4C6GB2TBSA?utm_campaign=producthunt-api&utm_medium=api-v2&utm_source=Application%3A+%E5%91%A8%E6%8A%A5-workMac+%28ID%3A+287503%29
  • Votes: 16 | Comments: 3
  • Offers a virtual assistant that delivers blunt feedback to cut through flattery, differentiating itself as a novelty tool for those who prefer directness.

🛠️ Developer Tools

QApilot's CoWork — 3x Mobile Automation. Same QE Team.

  • Product Hunt: https://www.producthunt.com/products/qapilot?utm_campaign=producthunt-api&utm_medium=api-v2&utm_source=Application%3A+%E5%91%A8%E6%8A%A5-workMac+%28ID%3A+287503%29
  • Website: https://www.producthunt.com/r/NSPNNAO4TQVQUD?utm_campaign=producthunt-api&utm_medium=api-v2&utm_source=Application%3A+%E5%91%A8%E6%8A%A5-workMac+%28ID%3A+287503%29
  • Votes: 298 | Comments: 63
  • Accelerates mobile test automation by 3x using AI co‑piloting, standing out with its promise to deliver the same quality engineering output without increasing headcount.

Cloud World Model — Simulate AWS, GCP & DigitalOcean without paying the bill

  • Product Hunt: https://www.producthunt.com/products/cloud-world-model?utm_campaign=producthunt-api&utm_medium=api-v2&utm_source=Application%3A+%E5%91%A8%E6%8A%A5-workMac+%28ID%3A+287503%29
  • Website: https://www.producthunt.com/r/XMLOOUK5PH6Y6V?utm_campaign=producthunt-api&utm_medium=api-v2&utm_source=Application%3A+%E5%91%A8%E6%8A%A5-workMac+%28ID%3A+287503%29
  • Votes: 168 | Comments: 49
  • Solves the cost barrier of cloud testing by providing a realistic simulator for AWS, GCP, and DigitalOcean, making it a safe sandbox for development and learning.

VibeRaven — Open-source mission control for AI-built apps

  • Product Hunt: https://www.producthunt.com/products/viberaven?utm_campaign=producthunt-api&utm_medium=api-v2&utm_source=Application%3A+%E5%91%A8%E6%8A%A5-workMac+%28ID%3A+287503%29
  • Website: https://www.producthunt.com/r/CCAXIKQAV7JMBB?utm_campaign=producthunt-api&utm_medium=api-v2&utm_source=Application%3A+%E5%91%A8%E6%8A%A5-workMac+%28ID%3A+287503%29
  • Votes: 15 | Comments: 5
  • Provides an open‑source orchestration layer for managing apps built on AI models, standing out with its focus on observability and control in agent‑powered software.

📊 AI Applications

AgentGrade — See how well AI agents can find, read, and cite your website

  • Product Hunt: https://www.producthunt.com/products/agentgrade?utm_campaign=producthunt-api&utm_medium=api-v2&utm_source=Application%3A+%E5%91%A8%E6%8A%A5-workMac+%28ID%3A+287503%29
  • Website: https://www.producthunt.com/r/B4YILDIVW3HZSA?utm_campaign=producthunt-api&utm_medium=api-v2&utm_source=Application%3A+%E5%91%A8%E6%8A%A5-workMac+%28ID%3A+287503%29
  • Votes: 10 | Comments: 4
  • Solves the problem of content discoverability by grading how well AI agents can retrieve and cite information from a website, helping marketers optimise for an AI‑first web.

🎨 Creative & Content

Folio AI — Claude for PowerPoint, on steroids

  • Product Hunt: https://www.producthunt.com/products/folio-ai?utm_campaign=producthunt-api&utm_medium=api-v2&utm_source=Application%3A+%E5%91%A8%E6%8A%A5-workMac+%28ID%3A+287503%29
  • Website: https://www.producthunt.com/r/334A7LA6L6NHLW?utm_campaign=producthunt-api&utm_medium=api-v2&utm_source=Application%3A+%E5%91%A8%E6%8A%A5-workMac+%28ID%3A+287503%29
  • Votes: 311 | Comments: 51
  • Automates PowerPoint creation with AI generation and design layout, standing out as today’s top‑voted product by offering a “Claude‑level” conversational interface for slide decks.

Market Signal

The day’s launches reveal a strong tilt toward developer productivity and agent orchestration. The two most‑voted products—Folio AI and QApilot—target concrete workflow bottlenecks (presentations and mobile testing), indicating that users reward pragmatic, ROI‑driven AI tools. Agent management is a rising sub‑theme: OpenBot and AgentGrade both focus on interacting with or evaluating AI agents, while VibeRaven provides the backend plumbing. The open‑source vs. closed‑source split is balanced—VibeRaven and Cloud World Model are open, while Folio AI and QApilot are closed. Notably, the simulation category (Cloud World Model) saw strong engagement, suggesting developers are hungry for cost‑free sandbox environments. The novelty product A.S.S.H.O.L.E. attracted modest attention, reflecting that gimmick AI still has an audience, but serious tooling dominated the top slots.

Worth Trying

  1. Cloud World Model – Ideal for devops engineers and cloud learners who want to practice infrastructure provisioning without incurring bills. Its realistic simulation of three major providers makes it a valuable sandbox for testing and education.

  2. OpenBot – Developers building multi‑agent systems should try its tag‑based agent management, which offers a simple mental model that could reduce orchestration complexity compared to traditional workflow engines.

  3. Velocity 2.0 Prompt Co‑Pilot – Anyone who writes prompts regularly will benefit from one‑click enhancement with context injection. It works across any AI tool, making it a lightweight addition to any AI‑centric workflow.

This digest is auto-generated by agents-radar.

item.content:encoded:
Hugging Face 热门模型日报 2026-06-28

数据来源: Hugging Face Hub | 共 30 个模型 | 生成时间: 2026-06-28 10:09 UTC

好的，以下是 2026-06-28 的《Hugging Face 热门模型日报》。

Hugging Face 热门模型日报 | 2026-06-28

📰 今日速览

本周 Hugging Face 生态呈现出“巨头林立、百花齐放”的态势。以 zai-org 的 GLM-5.2 为首的 MoE 模型家族（包括未量化、GGUF 和 NVIDIA NVFP4 版本）表现抢眼，占据了榜单头部。与此同时，Qwen 架构的衍生模型数量最多，从基础大模型到社区微调版本（如 Uncensored 变体）均有超高下载量。多模态趋势依旧强劲，视频理解模型 nvidia/LocateAnything-3B 和语音模型 nvidia/nemotron-3.5-asr 首次进入视线。社区量化活动频繁，HauhauCS 的“Uncensored”系列和 yuxinlu1 的“Fable5”系列成为本周微调最大赢家。

🏆 热门模型

🧠 语言模型（LLM、对话模型、指令微调）

  • zai-org/GLM-5.2 (zai-org, 👍2,716, 📥118,651) — 新一代混合专家模型（MoE），凭借强大的对话和生成能力，成为本周最受关注的通用 LLM。
  • empero-ai/Qwythos-9B-Claude-Mythos-5-1M (empero-ai, 👍506, 📥52,492) — 基于 Qwen3.5 的融合微调模型，主打推理与多模态理解，是“少量样本达到顶尖推理”口号的实践者。
  • Qwen/Qwen-AgentWorld-35B-A3B (Qwen, 👍369, 📥23,697) — Qwen 官方出品的面向 Agent 世界模型的大规模 MoE 模型，专注于智能体环境模拟与决策。
  • yuxinlu1/gemma-4-12B-agentic-fable5-composer2.5-v2-3.5x-tau2-GGUF (yuxinlu1, 👍747, 📥225,822) — 基于 Gemma 4 的 Agent 专用变体，结合“Fable5”微调范式，支持复杂终端交互与任务规划。
  • deepreinforce-ai/Ornith-1.0-397B (deepreinforce-ai, 👍130, 📥1,116) — 当前榜单最大参数量的模型，Qwen3.5 MoE 架构的极致缩放，适合需要极致广度与复杂推理的场景。
  • HauhauCS/Qwen3.6-35B-A3B-Uncensored-HauhauCS-Aggressive (HauhauCS, 👍2,285, 📥3,248,724) — 社区最受欢迎的无审查版本，本日下载量冠军，基于 Qwen3.6 的激进风格微调。
  • WeiboAI/VibeThinker-3B (WeiboAI, 👍742, 📥59,337) — 3B 参数的小钢炮，专注数学推理，是低成本部署和学术验证的理想选择。
  • LiquidAI/LFM2.5-230M (LiquidAI, 👍132, 📥12,384) — 230M 的轻量级模型，属于 Liquid 系列的最新迭代，主打边缘设备上的高效文本生成。
  • deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4-Pro-DSpark (deepseek-ai, 👍153, 📥373) — DeepSeek V4 的专业版，引入“DSpark”架构优化，代表闭源大模型的开源对抗力量。
  • Chunjiang-Intelligence/DeepSeek-v4-Fable (Chunjiang-Intelligence, 👍118, 📥1,409) — 基于 DeepSeek v4 的网络安全专用微调模型，聚焦攻防场景和日志分析。

🎨 多模态与生成（图像、视频、音频、文本到X）

  • baidu/Unlimited-OCR (baidu, 👍1,164, 📥295,064) — 百度的全能 OCR 模型，支持不限字符的高精度识别，下载量极大，是开源 OCR 的首选。
  • nvidia/LocateAnything-3B (nvidia, 👍2,418, 📥646,451) — NVIDIA 的目标定位基础模型，能从图像中精准定位任意物体，颠覆了传统视觉定位范式。
  • nvidia/nemotron-3.5-asr-streaming-0.6b (nvidia, 👍725, 📥67,419) — 600M 参数的流式语音识别模型，支持低延迟的实时转写，是音频领域的明星。
  • krea/Krea-2-Turbo (krea, 👍329, 📥27,631) — Krea 最新图像生成模型的 Turbo 版本，推理速度极快，基于其基础模型 Krea-2-Raw 的蒸馏优化。
  • krea/Krea-2-Raw (krea, 👍221, 📥22,622) — Krea 第二代图像生成的原始基础模型，提供最高的画质控制上限。
  • MiniMaxAI/MiniMax-M3 (MiniMaxAI, 👍1,255, 📥188,314) — MiniMax 第三代多模态大模型，统一理解与生成，支持图文混合输入，是目前最强视觉语言模型之一。
  • Comfy-Org/Krea-2 (Comfy-Org, 👍166, 📥10) — ComfyUI 官方发布的 Krea-2 工作流插件，方便用户在 ComfyUI 中调用 Krea 模型。

🔧 专用模型（代码、数学、医疗、嵌入）

  • yuxinlu1/gemma-4-12B-coder-fable5-composer2.5-v1-GGUF (yuxinlu1, 👍2,439, 📥549,926) — 基于 Gemma 4 的代码生成模型，采用“Fable5”和“Composer”微调策略，在编码任务上表现突出。
  • microsoft/FastContext-1.0-4B-SFT (microsoft, 👍368, 📥6,779) — 微软出品的长上下文微调模型，擅长处理超长文本（如整本小说或论文）和复杂信息提取。
  • WeiboAI/VibeThinker-3B (WeiboAI, 👍742, 📥59,337) — 作为数学专用模型，在此重复出现，强调其在数学推理领域的广泛应用。

📦 微调与量化（社区微调、GGUF、AWQ）

  • empero-ai/Qwythos-9B-Claude-Mythos-5-1M-GGUF (empero-ai, 👍699, 📥831,529) — Qwythos 模型的 GGUF 量化版本，极大降低了推理门槛，是本地化部署的热门选择。
  • yuxinlu1/gemma-4-12B-coder-fable5-composer2.5-v1-GGUF (yuxinlu1, 👍2,439, 📥549,926) — Gemma-4 Coder 的 GGUF 版本，量化后仍保持惊人的编码能力，是编程爱好者的首选量化模型。
  • unsloth/GLM-5.2-GGUF (unsloth, 👍429, 📥146,023) — unsloth 出品的高效 GLM-5.2 量化版，推理速度与易用性俱佳。
  • nvidia/GLM-5.2-NVFP4 (nvidia, 👍143, 📥45,762) — NVIDIA 利用 ModelOpt 对 GLM-5.2 进行 4-bit FP4 量化，在 NVIDIA 硬件上实现极致性能。
  • deepreinforce-ai/Ornith-1.0-35B-GGUF (deepreinforce-ai, 👍350, 📥79,630) — Ornith-35B 的 GGUF 版本，兼顾性能与体积，适合单卡运行。
  • deepreinforce-ai/Ornith-1.0-9B-GGUF (deepreinforce-ai, 👍236, 📥36,846) — Ornith-9B 的精简量化版，10B 以下模型中性价比极高的选择。
  • HauhauCS/Qwen3.6-35B-A3B-Uncensored-HauhauCS-Aggressive (HauhauCS, 👍2,285, 📥3,248,724) — 社区微调的杰出代表，GGE格式的“Uncensored”系列，因其过滤难度低、风格激进而广受追捧。
  • nvidia/Qwen3.6-35B-A3B-NVFP4 (nvidia, 👍367, 📥5,235,413) — NVIDIA 为 Qwen3.6 定制的 FP4 量化版，是目前下载量最高的量化模型之一，展示了硬件厂商对开源生态的深度支持。
  • huihui-ai/Huihui-gemma-4-12B-coder-fable5-composer2.5-v1-abliterated (huihui-ai, 👍138, 📥7,210) — “abliterated”系列的最新作品，通过移除安全对齐层来获得无约束的生成能力。
  • HauhauCS/Gemma4-12B-QAT-Uncensored-HauhauCS-Balanced (HauhauCS, 👍98, 📥40,820) — 采用QAT（量化感知训练）的Gemma 4无审查版，在保持性能的同时降低了部署延迟。
  • unsloth/Qwen-AgentWorld-35B-A3B-GGUF (unsloth, 👍84, 📥79,503) — unsloth 与 Qwen 合作带来的 AgentWorld 模型的量化版本，使 Agent 世界模型更易部署。

🌐 生态信号

  1. 模型家族“双子星”对决：GLM vs. Qwen。本周榜单清晰显示出两大模型生态的激烈竞争。GLM-5.2 家族凭借原创 MoE 结构占据高质量点赞榜首，而 Qwen 家族（3.5/3.6）则以海量的社区微调和量化版本（如 HauhauCS 的 Uncensored 系列）统治下载量。“Uncensored”社区微调成为最火爆的细分品类，社区对无审查模型的渴望远超预期。
  2. 开源权重持续主导。所有热门模型均为开源权重，未见纯 API 模型上榜。这标志着开源模型在性能和质量上已足以让社区充满创作热情，闭源模型更多通过论文（如 arxiv:2606.19348）或特定硬件支持（如 NVFP4）间接参与生态。
  3. 量化与硬件绑定加深。GGUF 仍是本地部署的绝对主流，但 NVIDIA 的 NVFP4 (ModelOpt) 异军突起，凭借大规模下载量（Qwen3.6 版超 500 万下载），表明硬件厂商正在通过量化工具链深度绑定自身生态，用户对“硬件优化+模型量化”的组合接受度极高。
  4. 多模态从“识别”走向“定位”。本周多模态热点从传统的图文理解（MiniMax-M3）转向了更精准的视觉定位（nvidia/LocateAnything-3B）和实时语音（nemotron-3.5-asr），体现模型能力正从“理解是什么”向“定位在哪里”“听懂说什么”升级。

🔭 值得探索

  1. GLM-5.2 及其量化版：作为本周最受瞩目的原创架构，其 MoE 设计在效率和能力平衡上值得深入研究。推荐理由：代表了当前非 Qwen/Llama 架构的最高水平，有很高的学术与工程价值。
  2. nvidia/LocateAnything-3B：开创了“零样本+开放词汇+任意目标”的定位新范式，是计算机视觉领域的重大突破。推荐理由：3B 参数量便达到如此高的泛化性，极有可能成为未来 AI 视觉 Agent 的标准基础组件。
  3. WeiboAI/VibeThinker-3B：在 3B 级别上实现了令人惊叹的数学推理能力。推荐理由：对于资源受限但需要高精度数学推理的应用场景，它可能是最具性价比的选择。

本日报由 agents-radar 自动生成。

item.content:encoded:
Hugging Face Trending Models Digest 2026-06-28

Source: Hugging Face Hub | 30 models | Generated: 2026-06-28 10:09 UTC

Hugging Face Trending Models Digest — 2026-06-28

Today's Highlights

This week's trending models are dominated by the Qwen 3.5/3.6 MoE ecosystem, with uncensored fine-tunes and quantized variants from community creators like HauhauCS drawing massive download counts (Qwen3.6-35B-A3B-Uncensored alone surpassed 3.2M downloads). Google's Gemma-4 continues strong momentum, particularly in coding and agentic fine-tunes (yuxinlu1's Gemma-4-12B-coder hit 2.4K weekly likes), while Baidu's Unlimited-OCR signals renewed interest in vision-language OCR at scale. NVIDIA makes a notable appearance with both LocateAnything-3B (2.4K likes) and their Model Optimizer quantizations (NVFP4), alongside new ASR streaming models. The Ornith-1.0 family from deepreinforce-ai spans 9B to 397B parameters, suggesting a growing appetite for diverse-size open-weight MoE architectures.

Trending Models

🧠 Language Models (LLMs, chat, instruction-tuned)

  • zai-org/GLM-5.2 — zai-org | 2,716 likes | 118,651 downloads
    The most-liked model this week: a Mixture-of-Experts conversational model for text generation building on the GLM architecture.

  • HauhauCS/Qwen3.6-35B-A3B-Uncensored-HauhauCS-Aggressive — HauhauCS | 2,285 likes | 3,248,724 downloads
    An uncensored, vision-capable MoE fine-tune of Qwen3.6 that has gone viral due to aggressive alignment removal and massive community demand.

  • deepreinforce-ai/Ornith-1.0-397B — deepreinforce-ai | 130 likes | 1,116 downloads
    The largest Ornith variant, a 397B-parameter MoE model for text generation pushing the boundaries of scale in open-weight LLMs.

  • deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4-Pro-DSpark — deepseek-ai | 153 likes | 373 downloads
    The official Pro variant of DeepSeek-V4 with agentic and distributed capabilities (DSpark), building on their v4 research.

  • WeiboAI/VibeThinker-3B — WeiboAI | 742 likes | 59,337 downloads
    A compact 3B Qwen2-based model specialized for mathematical reasoning — notable for its size-to-performance ratio.

  • LiquidAI/LFM2.5-230M — LiquidAI | 132 likes | 12,384 downloads
    A tiny 230M liquid foundation model exploring small-scale efficiency for text generation tasks.

  • microsoft/FastContext-1.0-4B-SFT — microsoft | 368 likes | 6,779 downloads
    A 4B SFT-tuned model designed for long-context applications, part of Microsoft's Explorer SubAgent initiative.

🎨 Multimodal & Generation (image, video, audio, text-to-X)

  • baidu/Unlimited-OCR — baidu | 1,164 likes | 295,064 downloads
    A cutting-edge OCR model from Baidu handling image-to-text extraction at scale — trending due to practical utility and strong performance.

  • empero-ai/Qwythos-9B-Claude-Mythos-5-1M — empero-ai | 506 likes | 52,492 downloads
    A Qwen3.5-based image-text-to-text model blending Claude-style reasoning with vision capabilities.

  • krea/Krea-2-Turbo — krea | 329 likes | 27,631 downloads
    The turbo variant of Krea-2 image generation model, optimized for faster inference while maintaining quality.

  • nvidia/LocateAnything-3B — nvidia | 2,418 likes | 646,451 downloads
    An image-feature-extraction model from NVIDIA for general-purpose object localization — extremely popular for its versatility and Nvidia's reputation.

  • MiniMaxAI/MiniMax-M3 — MiniMaxAI | 1,255 likes | 188,314 downloads
    A multimodal vision-language model supporting image-text-to-text, competing in the crowded VL space.

  • nvidia/nemotron-3.5-asr-streaming-0.6b — nvidia | 725 likes | 67,419 downloads
    A compact 0.6B streaming ASR model optimized for real-time speech recognition — signals Nvidia's push into efficient audio.

🔧 Specialized Models (code, math, vision/speech, embeddings)

  • yuxinlu1/gemma-4-12B-coder-fable5-composer2.5-v1-GGUF — yuxinlu1 | 2,439 likes | 549,926 downloads
    The most-liked specialized model: a Gemma-4-based GGUF fine-tune optimized for coding and reasoning with composer2.5 architecture.

  • yuxinlu1/gemma-4-12B-agentic-fable5-composer2.5-v2-3.5x-tau2-GGUF — yuxinlu1 | 747 likes | 225,822 downloads
    An agentic-on-terminal variant of the same Gemma-4 family, fine-tuned for autonomous coding and tool use.

  • huihui-ai/Huihui-gemma-4-12B-coder-fable5-composer2.5-v1-abliterated — huihui-ai | 138 likes | 7,210 downloads
    An "abliterated" (uncensored) version of the Gemma-4 coder, removing safety alignments for unrestricted coding use.

  • WeiboAI/VibeThinker-3B — WeiboAI (also listed under LLMs) — specialized for math reasoning.

  • Chunjiang-Intelligence/DeepSeek-v4-Fable — Chunjiang-Intelligence | 118 likes | 1,409 downloads
    A cybersecurity-focused DeepSeek-V4 fine-tune, applying the "Fable" variant to security tasks.

📦 Fine-tunes & Quantizations (GGUF, NVFP4, community adapts)

  • empero-ai/Qwythos-9B-Claude-Mythos-5-1M-GGUF — empero-ai | 699 likes | 831,529 downloads
    GGUF quantized version of Qwythos-9B for llama.cpp inference — extremely popular due to easy local deployment.

  • unsloth/GLM-5.2-GGUF — unsloth | 429 likes | 146,023 downloads
    Unsloth's GGUF quantization of GLM-5.2, enabling efficient inference on consumer hardware.

  • HauhauCS/Gemma4-12B-QAT-Uncensored-HauhauCS-Balanced — HauhauCS | 98 likes | 40,820 downloads
    A balanced, uncensored QAT quantization of Gemma-4-12B for multimodal vision-text tasks.

  • deepreinforce-ai/Ornith-1.0-35B-GGUF — deepreinforce-ai | 350 likes | 79,630 downloads
    GGUF quant of the 35B Ornith model, offering a middle ground between performance and accessibility.

  • nvidia/Qwen3.6-35B-A3B-NVFP4 — nvidia | 367 likes | 5,235,413 downloads
    NVIDIA's FP4 quantization of Qwen3.6, achieving extreme compression with minimal quality loss — the most-downloaded model this week.

  • nvidia/GLM-5.2-NVFP4 — nvidia | 143 likes | 45,762 downloads
    NVIDIA's FP4 quant of GLM-5.2, demonstrating cross-architecture quantization capabilities.

  • unsloth/Qwen-AgentWorld-35B-A3B-GGUF — unsloth | 84 likes | 79,503 downloads
    GGUF quant of the AgentWorld model, optimized for world-modeling and agent-based tasks.

Ecosystem Signal

The Qwen 3.5/3.6 MoE family has become the dominant open-weight ecosystem this week, with representation from original authors (Qwen), community fine-tuners (HauhauCS, empero-ai), and quantization partners (NVIDIA, unsloth). The sheer download volume (5.2M for NVFP4 quant, 3.2M for uncensored fine-tune) indicates these are the go-to base models for experimentation and deployment.

Gemma-4 is the clear runner-up, particularly in coding and agentic niches. The "fable5-composer2.5" fine-tune family (yuxinlu1, huihui-ai) shows a maturing ecosystem where community creators systematically push base models toward specific use cases (coder, agentic, abliterated). Notably, all three major open Coder models this week are Gemma-4 based.

Quantization formats are consolidating: GGUF (via unsloth, llama.cpp) remains the standard for local inference, while NVIDIA's NVFP4 gains traction as an enterprise-grade compressed format. The success of NVIDIA's Qwen3.6 NVFP4 quant (5.2M downloads) suggests hardware-optimized quantizations are becoming a distribution channel of their own.

Uncensored/abliterated models (HauhauCS, huihui-ai) continue to attract outsize engagement despite smaller author followings — the community appetite for unrestricted models remains strong, particularly for multimodal and coding domains.

Ornith-1.0 (deepreinforce-ai) launches a full spectrum from 9B to 397B, a rare case of a single family spanning all compute tiers. Their MIT licensing and endpoint compatibility tags suggest commercial deployment intent.

Open-weight vs. proprietary: All 30 trending models are open-weights. NVIDIA (nemotron-3.5 ASR, LocateAnything) and Microsoft (FastContext) are the only "big tech" contributors, but their models are fully open — indicating the center of gravity has decisively shifted to the open ecosystem.

Worth Exploring

1. nvidia/LocateAnything-3B — A standout for its 2.4K likes and 646K downloads: a general-purpose localization model that works across diverse visual domains. Its image-feature-extraction pipeline and Nvidia backing make it ideal for both production deployment and research into vision-based grounding.

2. Qwen/Qwen-AgentWorld-35B-A3B — The base model behind the AgentWorld family, specifically designed for world-modeling and agentic reasoning. With only 369 likes so far but a dedicated GGUF quant from unsloth already available, this represents an early-stage opportunity to explore next-gen interactive and simulation-based models.

3. LiquidAI/LFM2.5-230M — At just 230M parameters, this liquid foundation model offers a unique opportunity to study scaling dynamics and efficiency trade-offs in extremely small LLMs. Its popularity (132 likes) suggests growing interest in tiny models for edge deployment and rapid iteration — a contrarian signal in a MoE-giant week.

This digest is auto-generated by agents-radar.
